source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 21 May 1952, p. 10 ("County and rural council nominations"); Ballymena Weekly Telegraph, 6 June 1952, p. 5 ("Notice of Result of Elections: Rural District of Ballymena, 1952")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)

note: Triennial election of the rural district council, June 1952 (statutory day Thursday 5 June 1952). There was no poll. All 23 divisions are taken from the returning officer's notice of result (E. Hollinger, returning officer, Rural District Council Office, Cushendall Road, Ballymena, dated 5 June 1952; Ballymena Weekly Telegraph, 6 June 1952, p. 5): eighteen sole candidates were declared elected, and in Ballyclug, Glenravel, Glenwherry, Newtowncrommelin and Slemish the retiring members were deemed re-elected. No party labels are printed; places of abode are not reproduced. The notice spells two divisions Glenraville and Glenwhirry; the usual spellings are used here. In place of Mr. William Linton, who retired. Returned unopposed.
